# Setup
```{r setup}
library(clusterProfiler)

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))

figures.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 2/")

set.seed(123)
```



# Settings
```{r}
min.num.cells.pseudobulk <- 10

denoise.labels <- list()
denoise.labels[[1]] <- FALSE
denoise.labels[[2]] <- "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature"
```



# DEGs per cell type, postmortem vs surgical from Sussman 2024
```{r}
timepoint.of.interest <- "Progressive (Autopsy)"
downsample <- T
if (downsample) {
  downsample.label <- 100
} else {
  downsample.label <- FALSE
}

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))

seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = timepoint %in% c("Initial CNS Tumor", "Progressive (Autopsy)"))
```



# DEG analysis
```{r}
do.deg.analysis <- F

if (do.deg.analysis) {
  for (celltype.of.interest in sort(unique(seurat.obj$annotation.l2.w.qc))) {
    
    print(celltype.of.interest)
    
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = annotation.l2.w.qc == celltype.of.interest)
    seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures)
    
    # remove samples with less than min.num.cells.pseudobulk cell of cell type of interest
    cell.counts <- table(seurat.obj.subset$sample.id)
    keep.samples <- names(cell.counts[cell.counts >= min.num.cells.pseudobulk])
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = sample.id %in% keep.samples)
    
    if (downsample) {
      Idents(seurat.obj.subset) <- "sample.id"
      seurat.obj.subset$downsample <- T
      seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = downsample == T, downsample = downsample.label)
    } 
    
    Idents(seurat.obj.subset) <- "timepoint"
    
    
    for (i in 1:length(denoise.labels)) {
      denoise.label <- denoise.labels[[i]]
      print(denoise.label)
      covariates <- setdiff(unlist(str_split(denoise.label, "_")), "FALSE")
      print(covariates)
      
      if (length(covariates) == 0) {
        markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.obj.subset, 
                           ident.1 = "Progressive (Autopsy)", 
                           ident.2 = "Initial CNS Tumor",
                           test.use = "MAST")
      } else {
        markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.obj.subset, 
                           ident.1 = "Progressive (Autopsy)", 
                           ident.2 = "Initial CNS Tumor",
                           test.use = "MAST",
                           latent.vars = covariates)
      }
      
      markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
      
      write.table(markers, paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "DEGs/", celltype.of.interest, "_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_surgical_downsample=", downsample.label, "_denoise=", denoise.label, ".tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = F)
    }
  }
}
```



# Figure 2: Volcano plots
Start here after running DEG analysis in above chunk
```{r}
celltype.of.interest <- "Myeloid"
downsample.label <- 100

markers.before <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "DEGs/", celltype.of.interest, "_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_surgical_downsample=", downsample.label, "_denoise=", "FALSE", ".tsv"), sep = "\t")
markers.after <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "DEGs/", celltype.of.interest, "_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_surgical_downsample=", downsample.label, "_denoise=", "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature", ".tsv"), sep = "\t")


# test overlap with postmortem signatures
markers.before.filter.genes <- markers.before %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% pull(gene)
universe.genes <- rownames(seurat.obj)

results <- list()
results <- c(
    results,
    list(geneSetOverlapRow(
      "postmortem.signature",
      "markers.before.filter.genes",
      gene.signatures[["postmortem.signature"]],
      markers.before.filter.genes,
      universe.genes
    )),
    list(geneSetOverlapRow(
      "postmortem.sensitive",
      "markers.before.filter.genes",
      gene.signatures[["postmortem.sensitive"]],
      markers.before.filter.genes,
      universe.genes
    )),
    list(geneSetOverlapRow(
      "heat.shock.signature",
      "markers.before.filter.genes",
      gene.signatures[["heat.shock.signature"]],
      markers.before.filter.genes,
      universe.genes
    ))
  )
overlap.table <- do.call(rbind, results)
write.table(overlap.table, paste0(figures.dir, "postmortem_signatures_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_initial_degs_", celltype.of.interest, "_overlap_tests.csv"), sep = "\t", quote = F, col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)


stress.genes <- c("HSPA6", "MLKL", "SERPINH1", "HSP90AA1", "CASP1", "RIPK2", "SESN3")
myeloid.biology <- c("C1QA", "APOE", "GPNMB", "IFI27", "TYROBP", "ISG15", "SLC40A1")

for (denoise in c("before.denoise", "after.denoise")) {
  if (denoise == "before.denoise") {
    df <- markers.before
    title <- "Before denoising"
  } else {
    df <- markers.after
    title <- "After denoising"
  }

  df$gene.label <- sapply(df$gene, function(x) ifelse(x %in% c(myeloid.biology, stress.genes), x, ""))
  df$highlight <- sapply(df$gene, function(x) case_when(
    x %in% myeloid.biology ~ "Myeloid biology",
    x %in% stress.genes ~ "Stress",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
  df$highlight <- factor(df$highlight, levels = c("Myeloid biology", "Stress", "Other"))
  df <- df %>% arrange(desc(highlight))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj), label = gene.label)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = highlight), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, color = "black") + 
    geom_text_repel(aes(color = highlight), size = 6, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    xlab("log2FC Progressive (Autopsy) vs Initial CNS Tumor") +
    ylab("-log10 adjusted p-value") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("Myeloid biology", "Stress", "Other"), values = c("blue", "red", "darkgrey")) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Myeloid biology", "Stress", "Other"), values = c("blue", "red", "darkgrey")) +
    labs(fill = "Gene category") +
    guides(color = "none") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    ggtitle(title)
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, celltype.of.interest, "_", denoise, "_postmortem_vs_initial_volcano_plot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```




# GO analysis
```{r}
downsample.label <- 100
celltype.of.interest <- "Myeloid"
markers.before <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "DEGs/", celltype.of.interest, "_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_surgical_downsample=", downsample.label, "_denoise=", "FALSE", ".tsv"), sep = "\t")
markers.after <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "DEGs/", celltype.of.interest, "_sussman2024_postmortem_vs_surgical_downsample=", downsample.label, "_denoise=", "heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature", ".tsv"), sep = "\t")


stress_keywords <- c(
  "heat",
  "stress",
  "protein folding",
  "chaperone",
  "inclusion body",
  "proteostasis",
  "refolding",
  "mitochond",
  "protein localization"
)

immune_keywords <- c(
  "microglial",
  "macrophage",
  "phagocytosis",
  "dendritic cell",
  "tumor necrosis factor",
  "TNF",
  "immune",
  "inflammatory",
  "NOD",
  "interferon",
  "viral",
  "interleukin-10"
)


for (denoise in c("before.denoise", "after.denoise")) {
  if (denoise == "before.denoise") {
    df <- markers.before
     title <- "Before denoising"
  } else {
    df <- markers.after
     title <- "After denoising"
  }
  
  genes <- df %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% pull(gene)
  
  go.enrich <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                        keyType = 'SYMBOL',
                        readable = T,
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  
  go.enrich.df <- data.frame(go.enrich)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% filter(Count >= 5)
  
  
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% arrange(desc(FoldEnrichment))
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% head(20)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      go_category = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(tolower(Description),
                            paste(stress_keywords, collapse = "|")) ~ "Stress",
        stringr::str_detect(tolower(Description),
                            paste(immune_keywords, collapse = "|")) ~ "Myeloid biology",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
  go.enrich.df$text.color <- sapply(go.enrich.df$go_category, function(x) case_when(
    x == "Stress" ~ "red",
    x == "Myeloid biology" ~ "blue",
    TRUE ~ "darkgrey"
  ))
  print(max(go.enrich.df$Count))
  
  go.enrich.df$Description_short <- str_trunc(go.enrich.df$Description, width = 80)
  go.enrich.df$Description_short <- factor(go.enrich.df$Description_short, levels = rev(go.enrich.df$Description_short))
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% arrange(Description_short)
  p <- ggplot(go.enrich.df, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, y = Description_short, size = Count, color = qvalue)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = go.enrich.df$text.color)) +
    ylab("") +
    ggtitle(title) +
      scale_size(
      breaks = c(5, 10, 15, 20),  
      labels = c("5", "10", "15", "20"),
      range = c(2, 8)        
    )
  
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, celltype.of.interest, "_", denoise, "_postmortem_vs_initial_go_plot.pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```
